description: This file defines the 'ReviewerDecorator' class, which serves as a decorator for the Reviewer entity within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to access and modify Reviewer objects, specifically to set the associated Employee by employee number.

classes.name: ReviewerDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the Reviewer entity, providing additional methods and encapsulation for reviewer-related operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a specific Reviewer object.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the Reviewer based on the employee number, retrieving the Employee reference via ORM.
